text: He hadn’t even been to Moonvale
Helen had
the two of them would have been there
leaving Rio Dell
Jack had moved from the house to the barn
Jack had moved to the loft
Willoughby, come to work on his cheese
stepped across to the stile railing that fronted the loft
went out again through the door
scurrying toward a crack in the floorboards
he dashed through a chink in the barn wall
Jack fairly flew down the ladder
Jack started after him
He walked back into the barn
Willoughby strode back in
He chased the cat out
when I come up from town
climbed back up into the loft
He grabbed his hat and set out
chasing the things down
crabs chased both Skeezix and Dr Jensen from the beach
Dr Jensen had gone home
then come back
Jack walked along toward the bluffs
at Miss Flees’s when he’d stopped by
Jack walked across the meadow toward the carnival
walked back the way he’d come
angled over toward the Coast Road
strolled south to where Skeezix almost certainly was messing around on the beach
he’d come
Jack nodded and walked past
he were just strolling toward Table Bluffs Beach
had passed the carnival
he made his way toward the beach trail
Jack stepped around the wooden sheds
